ingestionTime.description: Timestamp when the raw report was ingested into the dashboard by the collector

reportName.description: Name of the source report file from which this record was extracted

reportFolder.description: Folder or path of the source report file from which this record was extracted

product_id.description: Product identifier from the DD (DHUS) interface (OData Id)

product_name.description: Product file name from the DD (DHUS) interface (OData Name)

content_length.description: Product file size in bytes (OData ContentLength)

creation_date.description: Date the product was created on the DD (DHUS) interface, used as the publication date

ingestion_date.description: Date the product was ingested into the DD (DHUS) interface (IngestionDate)

modification_date.description: Last modification date of the product on the DD (DHUS) interface (ModificationDate)

interface_name.description: Name of the DD (DHUS) interface instance the product was collected from

production_service_type.description: Type of the production service providing the product (DD)

production_service_name.description: Name of the DD production service instance providing the product
